90e48190d7f5.title: Google Cloud services largely restored in UK; Revolut services back up in Singapore
90e48190d7f5.snippet: A power outage at a Google Cloud data centre near London disrupted several UK banks and Revolut services, including in Singapore.

30525632dd12.title: How Singapore is preparing to keep its power grid reliable as demand grows
30525632dd12.snippet: Singapore's peak electricity demand is projected to grow by between 2.9 per cent and 6.5 per cent annually over the next decade, according to EMA.
